title: Understanding and Combating Shame
coreMove: Shame resilience starts by naming shame precisely, reality-checking the expectation behind it, and reaching for empathy before identity replaces responsibility.

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate shame from accountability after the angry email mistake
Make shame learnable rather than humiliating

exampleSpecs.stakes: mistaking cultural pressure for private weakness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use gendered shame interviews to reality-check expectations

exampleSpecs.stakes: criticism becoming a verdict on lovability
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep feedback attached to behavior, not identity
Name male shame around weakness without mocking it
Move shame into empathic relationship before repair
